# SC-27 tests

Commands are listed only for files that exist. Run them from the repository root. Nothing here is run automatically.

## Static checks

- Claim file: `lake env lean scenarios/SC-27/claim.lean`
- Scenario bundle (manifest schema, hashes): `python3 tools/check_scenarios.py`
- Lean module: `lake build ControlStack.Scenarios.SC27Chain`

## Harness

- Runner: `scenarios/SC-27/harness/run_sc27.py` (see its docstring; live runs may need root, and evidence runs need the frozen prereg)
